name: Modbus Mock Device
description: Mock Modbus TCP device with a realistic register map (coils, discrete inputs, input registers, holding registers) that periodically mutates to mimic live plant data.
fidelity: simulated industrial process / mock device (not a hardware emulator).

requirements.name: Python 3.10+
requirements.description: Required to run the mock device.

requirements.name: uv package manager
requirements.description: Required to install pinned dependencies and run the mock device.

fields.label: Listen Interface
fields.description: Bind address: localhost only, Lab Host network, or custom.

fields.label: Port
fields.description: TCP port for the mock device.

fields.label: Update Interval (s)
fields.description: How often the mock mutates simulated process values.

start.notes: Starts via the Morgana compatibility shim, not the upstream module entry point. The pinned upstream mock cannot bind its datastore on any pymodbus release inside its own declared range (pymodbus>=3.5,<4); the shim compensates and leaves the upstream file unmodified. See pymodbus_pin.

runtime_pins.reason: Lowest measured release where the upstream simulation loop and the Modbus datastore both work. pymodbus>=3.13 raises TypeError('0 <= address < 65535') because ModbusSequentialDataBlock now subtracts 1 from the address and no longer exposes setValues/getValues.

known_upstream_defects.symptom: TypeError 0 <= address < 65535 at build_context(), or AttributeError 'dict' object has no attribute 'async_getValues' on every read, depending on pymodbus release.
known_upstream_defects.scope: mock device only; industriconnect-modbus-v1 Scripts use the modbus-mcp server, not the mock
